## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: mixed sector leadership (Communication, Energy, Industrials up while Technology and Healthcare lag) and a major divergence across large caps (multiple 1W vs 1M mismatches), supporting a neutral stance; Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Communication in Top 5).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Communication leads: VZ (1W: +12.65% | 1M: +11.28%) ABOVE TREND, T (1W: +11.11% | 1M: +6.88%) ABOVE TREND, TMUS (1W: +6.01% | 1M: -3.23%) RECOVERY. Energy strong: CVX (1W: +6.11% | 1M: +16.14%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +5.98% | 1M: +10.77%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +4.76% | 1M: +16.87%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials showing strength: LMT (1W: +7.35% | 1M: +29.96%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +4.91% | 1M: +14.12%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology lagging: MSFT (1W: -7.65% | 1M: -11.73%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -7.10% | 1M: -16.33%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: +1.84% | 1M: +1.91%) ABOVE TREND (pockets of strength). Healthcare weak: UNH (1W: -19.46% | 1M: -13.62%) BELOW TREND, TMO (1W: -7.57% | 1M: -0.83%) BELOW TREND, CVS (1W: -10.23% | 1M: -5.91%) BELOW TREND. Materials showing rotation/volatility with NEM (1W: -9.62% | 1M: +10.30%) CORRECTION.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: VZ (1W: +12.65% | 1M: +11.28%) ABOVE TREND, TXN (1W: +12.23% | 1M: +23.68%) ABOVE TREND, T (1W: +11.11% | 1M: +6.88%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +8.76% | 1M: +7.59%) ABOVE TREND, CHTR (1W: +7.53% | 1M: -1.66%) RECOVERY — Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Communication).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: ORCL (1W: -7.10% | 1M: -16.33%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -7.65% | 1M: -11.73%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -11.53% | 1M: -25.38%) BELOW TREND, NOW (1W: -12.10% | 1M: -24.13%) BELOW TREND, UNH (1W: -19.46% | 1M: -13.62%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in large-cap software and healthcare.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Top 1W movers: VZ (1W: +12.65% | 1M: +11.28%) ABOVE TREND, TXN (1W: +12.23% | 1M: +23.68%) ABOVE TREND, T (1W: +11.11% | 1M: +6.88%) ABOVE TREND; Watch AAPL (1W: +4.61% | 1M: -4.98%) RECOVERY and TMUS (1W: +6.01% | 1M: -3.23%) RECOVERY for potential follow-through; MAJOR divergence present — treat momentum as tactical.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed, leaning corrective with select leaders. MSFT (1W: -7.65% | 1M: -11.73%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -7.10% | 1M: -16.33%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: +1.84% | 1M: +1.91%) ABOVE TREND — sector-level weakness but isolated AI/semiconductor strength.

8. Financials Outlook?
Mixed/recovery in parts. JPM (1W: +2.74% | 1M: -4.99%) RECOVERY, V (1W: -1.33% | 1M: -8.99%) BELOW TREND, MA (1W: +2.68% | 1M: -6.55%) RECOVERY — financials showing selective rebounds but not broad confirmation.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Soft and under pressure. JNJ (1W: +3.23% | 1M: +9.83%) ABOVE TREND is an outlier, while UNH (1W: -19.46% | 1M: -13.62%) BELOW TREND and TMO (1W: -7.57% | 1M: -0.83%) BELOW TREND highlight sector-wide stress.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Neutral regime — favor selective exposure to top communication and energy names (VZ, CVX, TXN) and Industrials strength (LMT, CAT), reduce exposure to large-cap tech incumbents showing sustained 1W/1M weakness (MSFT, ORCL, INTU), and monitor major divergence before expanding risk; Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: VZ (1W: +12.65% | 1M: +11.28%) ABOVE TREND (news +80 confirming price), TXN (1W: +12.23% | 1M: +23.68%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +3.23% | 1M: +9.83%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: UNH (1W: -19.46% | 1M: -13.62%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -7.10% | 1M: -16.33%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -7.65% | 1M: -11.73%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Communication (1W: +5.35% | 1M: +1.10%) — watch VZ/T/T for leadership; Energy (1W: +2.51% | 1M: +13.35%) — CVX/COP momentum. BEARISH: Technology (1W: -0.98% | 1M: -1.96%), Healthcare (1W: -2.16% | 1M: -0.42%) — watch for continued dispersion.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA (1W: +1.84% | 1M: +1.91%) ABOVE TREND — resistance near prior highs (~900) for confirmation of broad tech follow-through. AAPL (1W: +4.61% | 1M: -4.98%) RECOVERY — keep an eye on 1M pivot (~180) for sustained recovery. JPM (1W: +2.74% | 1M: -4.99%) RECOVERY — watch 200 area for continuation of financial rebound.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
VZ (+80): Verizon resets story with Frontier deal and $25b buyback; price ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.65% | 1M: +11.28%) — sentiment confirmed. JNJ (+80): Myeloma approval headline; price ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.23% | 1M: +9.83%) — confirming accumulation. V (+55): Visa Q1 revenue jump; price BELOW TREND (1W: -1.33% | 1M: -8.99%) — divergence, watch for earnings-driven re-rate.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
ORCL (-60): Wall Street concerns on AI spending; price BELOW TREND (1W: -7.10% | 1M: -16.33%) — sentiment confirmed. UNH (-60): earnings shock and Medicare strain; price BELOW TREND (1W: -19.46% | 1M: -13.62%) — confirmed risk. NVDA (-45): concerns on AI chip exports to China; price ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.84% | 1M: +1.91%) — sentiment/price divergence to monitor.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. VZ (1W: +12.65% | 1M: +11.28%) ABOVE TREND, TXN (1W: +12.23% | 1M: +23.68%) ABOVE TREND and META (1W: +8.76% | 1M: +7.59%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major 1W/1M divergences among large caps (MSFT, ORCL, UNH BELOW TREND) and conflicting sentiment on NVDA despite price resilience — watch for trend confirmation.
